raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Exactly 30 raw_transactions rows carry record_version=2, and each duplicated txn_id has one version-1 row, so the duplicates are restated versions of existing transactions. Silver keeps every version, so the 30 txn_ids appear twice. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter removes the duplicates and respects a reversal in the newer version.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) latest WHERE latest.status = 'POSTED';"}}
